clue.text: A contest to fire people!

parts.note: to fire someone from a job is to sack them
a race is a people sharing descent

explanation.surface: An exclamation that a competition exists to dismiss staff.
explanation.walkthrough: A sack race is a children's sports-day event, run with both legs inside a sack.
explanation.definitionFit: This hopping race is a traditional school sports-day competition.

clue.text: Resort to corporal punishment for a change

definitions.meaning: to beat with a thin cane or rod
an exchange or substitution of one thing for another

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to whip with a cane; as a noun, a shift or swap.

clue.text: Caught with the money too — it's a plant!

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
L stands for pound, from Latin libra, the sign of British money
over can mean too, as in over-eager

explanation.surface: A criminal arrested with the cash reveals the evidence was planted.
explanation.definitionFit: Clover is a small leafy plant with three-lobed leaves.

clue.text: The man making out a buyer's been found for his property?

definitions.meaning: one who makes out, that is understands or perceives

definitions.text: a buyer's been found for his property?
definitions.meaning: one who has sold his assets and turned them into cash

explanation.definitionFit: To realise is both to understand and to sell an asset for cash; the agent noun covers both.

clue.text: About to cut grind

parts.note: c, short for circa, means about
to hew is to cut with an axe

explanation.surface: Ready to chop and crush something.
explanation.definitionFit: To chew is to grind food with the teeth.

clue.text: A kiss and it's over

parts.note: a cross (X) is the written sign for a kiss

explanation.surface: One kiss and the romance is finished.
explanation.definitionFit: Over and across both mean on or to the other side of something.

clue.text: Article absorbed by shrewd old royal personage

indicators.note: the article is taken into the middle of the word for shrewd

parts.note: cute can mean clever or shrewd
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece is taken in by a cunning former monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Canute was an eleventh-century king of England, Denmark and Norway.

clue.text: Actor getting awfully poor rate

indicators.note: done awfully, the letters are badly jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A performer is paid an awful wage.
explanation.definitionFit: One who operates is one who acts or performs a task.

clue.text: Produce notes about many a worker's leaning

indicators.note: the word for producing notes goes around the other pieces

parts.note: to sing is to produce musical notes
L is the Roman numeral fifty, used for many
the ant is the crossword's standard worker

explanation.surface: Writing music about the leanings of many a worker.
explanation.definitionFit: Slanting means sloping or leaning to one side.

clue.text: Devotee of one party — but not immediately

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a do is a party or celebration
something done later is not done straight away

explanation.surface: A loyal follower of a political party who is slow to commit.
explanation.definitionFit: A worshipper of idols, by extension any ardent admirer or devotee.

clue.text: Spirit shown by a girl

parts.note: an angel is a heavenly spirit

explanation.surface: A young woman shows plenty of spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: Angela is a girl's given name.

clue.text: Make a picture of the leftover fish

parts.note: read as 'the left over', port is the left side of a ship, placed above
the ray is a flat fish

explanation.surface: Painting the scraps of a fish supper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leftover' must be split: port (left) goes over the fish in this down answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To portray is to depict or represent in a picture.

clue.text: Belief in the cashless society?

definitions.meaning: to give ... to a story is to believe it
a world without cash runs on deferred payment, buying now and paying later

explanation.definitionFit: Credit means trust in something's truth, and also buying on deferred payment instead of cash.

clue.text: Shrink from a binding agreement

definitions.meaning: to shrink is to become smaller, to draw in
a legal agreement enforceable in law

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to get smaller; the noun is a legally binding deal.

clue.text: Turner the delinquent is keeping quiet

indicators.note: the wrongdoer holds the musical letter inside

parts.note: a delinquent is a wrongdoer, a sinner
p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: Painter Turner as a young offender who keeps his mouth shut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turner' suggests the painter, but here it is anything that turns.
explanation.definitionFit: A spinner is something that spins or turns, as a top or a spin bowler.

clue.text: Oppressors of the French made to accept notice

indicators.note: the French word is forced to take the synonym for notice inside it

parts.note: des is French for 'of the' with a plural noun
to notice something is to spot it

explanation.surface: French tyrants were forced to take note of a warning.
explanation.definitionFit: Despots are tyrants who rule oppressively.

clue.text: Almost no-one can find the time

indicators.note: almost the whole word means the word given minus its final letter

explanation.surface: Hardly anybody manages to find the time.
explanation.definitionFit: Midday is a particular time of day.

clue.text: Being exceptionally odd, he was followed

indicators.note: the letters behave unusually, rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A man who was trailed because he was very strange.
explanation.definitionFit: To be shadowed is to be followed secretly.

clue.text: Biscuits or nuts?

explanation.definitionFit: Plain thin biscuits share the word with slang for mad.

clue.text: Only sherry will be offered in this ocean-going vessel!

definitions.text: Only sherry will be offered in this ocean-going vessel!

parts.words: Only sherry will be offered in this ocean-going vessel!
parts.note: the name of a large sherry glass is also that of a sailing ship, so the drinking vessel poses as a ship

explanation.definitionFit: A tall sherry glass and a fore-and-aft rigged sailing ship share the name.

clue.text: The ideal man gives a woman love

parts.note: her is the pronoun for a woman
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: The perfect man is one who gives his love to a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A hero is a man admired as a model of excellence.

clue.text: Mental image of early childhood?

parts.note: split into two words, the answer describes something existing only in imagination, while read whole it is a baby's first years

explanation.definitionFit: The years of babyhood, the earliest stage of childhood.

clue.text: A star's moving device

definitions.meaning: one of the two bright stars of Gemini
a small swivelling wheel on furniture

explanation.definitionFit: It names a star in Gemini and a small wheel that lets furniture move.

clue.text: Senseless set-up to appeal for stuff

indicators.note: in a down answer, set up means written upwards, reversed

parts.note: mad means senseless or crazy
to ask is to appeal for something

explanation.surface: A foolish scheme to beg for possessions.
explanation.definitionFit: Damask is a patterned woven fabric, and stuff means cloth.

clue.text: A college mentor newly-appointed

indicators.note: the letters are newly arranged, given a fresh order

explanation.surface: A college has appointed a new tutor.
explanation.definitionFit: Merton is one of the colleges of Oxford University.

clue.text: Late last month got better

parts.note: December, abbreviated Dec, is the last month of the year
pain that has eased has got better

explanation.surface: Late last month the patient's condition improved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Late' looks like a time word with 'last month', but it is the definition, as in 'the late Mr Smith'.
explanation.definitionFit: The late someone is a person who has died.

clue.text: For example a head backing introductory course

indicators.note: the whole run of words is read in reverse order

parts.note: the top is the head of something

explanation.surface: Someone backing a leader on an induction course, for instance.
explanation.definitionFit: Thick soup is served as a starter, the opening course of a meal.

clue.text: Expert in installing cable television

indicators.note: the answer is set inside the word cable

explanation.surface: A specialist in fitting cable TV.
explanation.definitionFit: An able person is skilled, competent at a task.

clue.text: Forces others to go in different directions

indicators.note: the others are placed inside the pair of compass points

parts.note: west and south are compass points, W and S
the rest are the others

explanation.surface: Someone compels everyone else to scatter.
explanation.definitionFit: To wrest something is to force or wrench it away.

clue.text: Overflowing tub and an arrangement made for it

indicators.note: an arrangement made of the letters means they are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A bath tub filled to overflowing, set up deliberately.
explanation.definitionFit: Something overflowing is plentiful, present in great quantity.

clue.text: Leave the area with a water-shortage

definitions.meaning: to abandon or walk out on someone
an arid region with little rainfall

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to abandon; the noun is an arid region with little rain.

clue.text: Capital investment supports the family

parts.note: to bear a weight is to support it
kin are one's family

explanation.surface: Money invested in a business that keeps a family afloat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' means head and 'investment' clothing, so a capital investment is headwear, not finance; a guardsman's tall fur hat.
explanation.definitionFit: The fur hat of British Guards is something worn on the head, punningly an investment of the head.
